question: The value of frac{{(13)³ - 4³}}{13 -8 div 2} ÷ 8 – {2 + 6 × 9} is:
solution:
Concept Used:

Follow the BODMAS rule according to the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/39d5d53fbef7cb246c82384c70b63b0287aa26f6cdb11ad3d427215025057797.png] 

Calculation:

frac{{(13)³ - 4³}}{13 -8 ÷ 2} ÷ 8 – {2 + 6 × 9}

⇒ (2197 – 64)/(13 – 8 ÷ 2) ÷ 8 – {2 + 6 × 9}

⇒ 2133/(13 – 4) ÷ 8 – {2 + 6 × 9)

⇒ 2133/9 ÷ 8 – {2 + 54}

⇒ 237 ÷ 8 – 56

⇒ 237/8 – 56

⇒ (237 – 448)/8

⇒ -211/8

**∴ The required value is -(211)/(8).**
